copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 它把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器文件复制进 src/channels/,追加一行注册导入、安装指定版本的依赖,再跑构建和注册测试;随后提示你填 Meta 的四个凭据并写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp Business Cloud API 时触发;若正在跑 /setup 或 /manage-channels,也会接上这一步。

say.text: 把 WhatsApp Cloud 频道加到我的 NanoClaw 项目里
say.note: 会复制适配器并注册依赖

say.text: 凭据都填好了,帮我重新构建并跑注册测试
say.note: 跑 pnpm run build 和该 vitest 文件
旧安装升级时改 Meta 回调地址

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, appends a registration import, installs @chat-adapter/whatsapp at a pinned version, then runs build and the registration test. It also prompts for four Meta credentials and writes them to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to connect NanoClaw to the WhatsApp Business Cloud API. Also used during /setup or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel to my NanoClaw project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and registers the dependency.

say_en.text: Credentials are set - rebuild and run the registration test.
say_en.note: Runs pnpm run build and the vitest file.
For installs upgrading from the older adapter.
